name: institution_connection
description: A relationship one household has established with one institution, and the single plane it opens. A connection is granted by the institution to that household: it makes a plane readable for them alone, never for this estate, never for other households, and never for anyone reading the institution's public page. Establishing it is not a claim the institution agreed; it is a claim the household says it holds, recorded with who said so and when, and it is revocable by the household at any time.
